title: While it was happening

grammar.explainAr:
لربط حدث طويل مستمر في الماضي بحدث قصير قطعه نستعمل:
While + was / were + فعل ينتهي بـ ing، ثم الماضي البسيط في الشطر الثاني.
examples: While Yousif was packing his bag, the telephone rang.
While the boys were playing football, it started to rain.
While Ali was digging in the garden, he found a ring.

sentences: While Yousif was packing his bag, the telephone rang.
While we were having a picnic, it started to rain.
While Sarah was watching television, someone knocked.
While Kareem was swimming, he saw a big fish.
While the children were walking in the forest, they saw a bear.
While Ali was digging, he found a gold ring.
